d: Internal atrium in the castle of Binasco. A wing of the palace is illuminated. Everything indicates that a party takes place in that one. Some Cortigiani cross the scene, and meet in Philip.
Anichino and Orombello.
Agnes' apartment. Agnes sits restless at a coffee table: a lute is over it. After a few moments it gets up, and goes.
Horombello enters hasty, and watching. As soon as he discovers Agnes stops wondering and looking around.
Agnes alone.
Wood in the ducal garden. Beatrice runs out; her Damigelle follow her.
As Beatrice walks away with her damsel, Philip and Rizzardo enter. Both observe her in silence from afar.
Beatrice and Philip.
Filippo and Rizzardo.
Remote part in the castle of Binasco: on one side is the statue of Facino Dog. A Armigeri's drape comes out of the corridor and goes into the guarding.
Beatrice alone, then Orombello.
Filippo, Rizzardo, Agnese con seguito, Anichino, indi Cavalieri, Dame e Soldati.
Room in the castle of Binasco prepared to hold court. Guards at the doors. Damsel of Beatrice and Cortigiani.
Filippo, Anichino, Soldiers.
The Judges come out, and they go to their seats. Rizzardo presides over the council. Filippo sits in a high seat. The scene is impious of ladies and knights: among the ladies seen Agnes.
Beatrice between the Guards, and sayings
Horumbello between the Guards, and sayings.
Agnes and Philip.
Filippo solo, indi Anichino, Dame, Cortigiani.

Dressing ground that puts to the prisons of the castle. Large arch to which it ascends for a staircase and gives access to long external corridor. Damsel, and Family of Beatrice come out of the prisons. They are all dressed in mourning. - On each side Sentinels.
Beatrice comes out of the prison humbly dressed, and with her hair on the humerus: she walks slowly and effortlessly. Everyone surrounds her soft and silently.
Agnese hears Beatrice's words from above, shouts and goes down quickly.
Rizzardo with Alabardieri and Officers, shows up on the steps.
